motion-action-button: Creates a fingerprint of this sample only; it does not inspect or certify a proof. Requires Web Crypto in a secure context.
motion-expanding-button-group: On touch, tap once to reveal a collapsed action label, then tap again to activate.
motion-copy-button: Clipboard access depends on browser support, a secure context and permission.
motion-resizable-panels: The proof canvas scrolls within a narrow pane so its text keeps the selected size.
motion-otp-input: This compares a sample code locally; no code is delivered and no identity is verified.
motion-user-menu: No account service is connected. Sign out closes this menu; theme selection affects only its paper sample.
motion-chat-thread: Messages and reactions stay in this preview; nothing is sent to another person or service.
motion-comment-thread: Comments, mentions and resolution stay in this preview; no one is notified.
motion-signup-form: Local form example only. No account or subscription is created.
motion-sign-in: Local code comparison and method choices only; no identity, provider account or passkey is verified.
motion-login-centered: Local method records only; no account, email delivery or passkey verification is connected.
